**[P2] Preserve containment when every clock sample is interrupted**

Choosing the midpoint leaves up to half the sampling window plus `Date.now()` truncation as epoch error. The all-stalled fixture observes a ±5 ms residual and skips user-span containment, so scheduler or GC pauses across all three samples can still place synchronous user spans outside SDK parents. Retain the bracket endpoints, use the lower bound for starts and upper bound for events/ends in both plugins, and assert containment for the stalled fixtures.
